summary: Frontend responsive sidebar tested across 3 viewports (Desktop 1280x800, Mobile 390x800, Tablet 768x1024) with Lyra admin login. All specified behaviors verified: desktop collapse toggle (256px<->64px) with localStorage persistence, title-attribute tooltips when collapsed, mobile drawer with hamburger/backdrop/close/nav-auto-close, tablet uses drawer mode. No horizontal scroll on mobile. Short date and responsive KPI/padding confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx is clean and well-structured (~172 lines). Uses proper responsive Tailwind (fixed + transform on mobile, lg:sticky w-64/w-16 desktop).

Minor: spec mentions KPI font 22px @ mobile but there is an additional @media (max-width:400px) rule setting it to 20px. At iPhone-size 390px it renders 20px which is intentional; behavior consistent with 'mengecil' requirement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Responsive sidebar (Layout.jsx) verified. data-testids: sidebar, sidebar-open, sidebar-close, sidebar-backdrop, sidebar-toggle-desktop. localStorage key eklaim_sidebar_collapsed persists collapse state.
